entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A planeswalker and storyline character whose name appears on many cards, from Glasses of Urza onward.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker, a Cat Soldier whose pride thrives at his side; he has another form, Ajani Vengeant.

entities.name: Ajani Vengeant
entities.description: Ajani's other form, with a Lightning Helix ability.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker described as a mind mage, as blue as you can get.

entities.name: Jace, the Mind Sculptor
entities.description: A version of Jace with a Brainstorm ability, released in Worldwake.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who specializes in magics of the undead and the deadly.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: An impulsive fire mage and planeswalker, good at throwing damage at the face.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A hunter and beastmaster planeswalker, a one-man menagerie whose beasts are his companions and arsenal.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker whose staff and headdress appear in card art.

entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: A character whose plunge from the deck of the Weatherlight is depicted in Broken Fall.

entities.name: Selenia
entities.description: A character who tried to aid Gerrard when he fell.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The ship from whose deck Gerrard plunged.

entities.name: Skyshroud Forest
entities.description: A forest whose broken branches appear in the art of Broken Fall.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: A planeswalker depicted on the shield in the art of Dauntless Escort.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: The plane where the planeswalker card type premiered.

events.summary: Gerrard plunges from the deck of the Weatherlight, with Selenia attempting to aid him, as depicted in the art of Broken Fall.
events.quote: Gerrard's plunge from the deck of the Weatherlight , the attempted aid of Selenia, and the broken branches of Skyshroud Forest

relations.note: Both versions are Jace with different abilities.
relations.quote: Jace is a mind mage—as blue as you can get.
